title: A flat ring map with proper extended maximal ideals is faithfully flat
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a flat ring map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] such that for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m\subset R$ the ideal $\mathfrak mS$ of $S$ generated by $\varphi(\mathfrak m)$ is not all of $S$ (equivalently $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak m)=S/\mathfrak mS\neq0$). Then $\varphi$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map].
